entry: mail_links::record / link_for (the mails read for a session and the link offered for a URL), mail_reads::record (which tool results are a built-in mail read), the browser tool's navigate (the mail_link it hands the host command)

exclusions.connectorLinks: the `links` the Node connector extracted from each scripted message (HTML hyperlinks and text URIs) are recorded as an observation and not replayed: the core has no Gmail IMAP reader, so the recorded read_email results are the inputs of the replay
exclusions.navigateText: the text and isError of a navigate the desktop answered (Navigated to / refused by the secret-token rule) belong to the desktop host, which stays (apps/desktop/src/main/browser/url-policy.ts mailLinkAdmits, covered by url-policy.test.mjs); the replay compares them only where the runtime itself refused (a claimed mail_link) and where nothing reached the host
exclusions.the desktop checks the runtime-set link: the second test of mail-link-navigation.test.mjs forges a bridge command with a mail_link naming another URL: only the desktop receives such a command, the core never builds one; not recorded

normalised.reason: per-run temp path (or generated name) replaced by a placeholder

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay.compare: each case's operations in recorded order: record / dispatch / probe / navigate, every answer compared whole (a link is {url, from_domain, read_at}; a navigate hands the host exactly the recorded command's fields beside action and session_id)
